argumentation_roles.role: Q1 representation -> feature reduction -> classifier evidence
argumentation_roles.lesson: Separate data/feature evidence from generic algorithm schematics; a confusion matrix on grouped holdout is stronger than several textbook model diagrams.
Use aligned residual/error plots and held-out-temperature folds. Surface closeness is calibration evidence, not extrapolation evidence.
Crossed boxplots describe cells, but synergy requires an interaction effect/contrast plot with uncertainty after adjusting f/Bm.
Model architecture figure, code architecture and input schema must agree. For generalization, add grouped condition holdout rather than only Gaussian-noise perturbation.
Plot fronts on identical normalized axes, mark infeasible points, and report hypervolume/IGD/spread plus repeated-run uncertainty; visual concentration alone is not a quality metric.
